text:
maya (design): dropped two small frames for the account-settings form. open: inline field errors vs a single summary, compact required indicators, and delete-confirm for linked resources. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/forms-mini
eden (product): my priority is clarity for first-time users. summary banner helps when multiple fields fail, but inline hints speed up quick fixes. which to surface first?
ravi (eng): tech: inline errors are easier to attach to validators and keep fixes local. summary requires collecting all errors server/client side. we can show both: inline primary + collapsed summary if >3 errors.
sam (a11y): accessibility: always ensure errors are announced. use aria-live polite for helper hints and assertive/role=alert for blocking errors. asterisk alone is ambiguous for screen readers; use aria-required and visible text when possible.
maya (design): propose pattern: 1) validate onBlur for non-critical checks (polite), 2) onSubmit run authoritative checks and show assertive summary + focus to first invalid field. for required marker: use small "Required" under field in onboarding, compact "(req)" for dense lists.
eden (product): sounds reasonable. for destructive delete: small sets -> toast undo, mid sets -> modal + checkbox, very large or org-scoped -> typed-confirm. thresholds to be A/B tested.
ravi (eng): implementation notes: toast undo relies on soft-delete retention; typed-confirm must verify against a stable id server-side. also avoid layout shift by reserving 1 line under inputs for potential errors.
sam (a11y): typed-confirm can be a barrier. if we use it, provide an alternative confirmation (checkbox + explicit label) and make sure text entry fields have clear aria-label and autocomplete off. keep copy plain: e.g., "Delete 12 projects referencing connector X. This cannot be undone."
lighthouse-bot: design-lint: contrast check passed for base tokens; manual review advised for --error-red-500 on small text.
maya (design): action items: update figma with onBlur/polite and onSubmit/assertive flows, add compact required mock, and build modal variants (toast, checkbox-modal, typed-confirm). will tag for review and include short A/B plan for thresholds.
eden (product): please include microcopy variants (3 tones) so we can run quick user checks. thanks!
